adjudication.depicted_input: TeamPath architecture/system panels showing pathology image input and text prompt/instruction input entering Expert Vis Encoder and Expert Lang Encoder for downstream pathology VQA, summarization, and generation uses.
adjudication.rationale: The current figure 5 crop is defensible for corrector workflows, but figure 2 is visibly better because it directly depicts the paper’s shared TeamPath input mechanism: pathology image plus text prompt/instruction entering the model encoders. Under the atlas rules, a shared architecture figure can support multiple named variants when they use the same depicted input path, including evaluation and fine-tuning routes. This crop excludes the mostly post-hoc ranking panel and centers the actual input/interface panels.
